description: Work with your BlackLine financial close: users and teams, journal entries, reports, data imports, Transaction Matching and the audit trail, and start workflows when journals, imports, reports or periods change.

blackline_import_failed_trigger.description: Runs each time a data import into BlackLine finishes without succeeding. Ones that failed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.import: The whole import, with its files and steps.
output.name: The import's name.

blackline_import_finished_trigger.description: Runs each time a data import into BlackLine finishes, whether or not it succeeded. Ones finished before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.import: The whole import, with its files and steps.
output.name: The import's name.

blackline_journal_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a journal entry's posting status changes in BlackLine, and for each new journal, in a period (the current one unless you pick another) that the chosen role can see. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.journal: The whole journal as BlackLine lists it.
output.title: The journal's title.

parameters.description: The role whose journals to watch, such as Preparer. Leave empty for the connected user's default role.
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.description: The period to watch. Leave empty for the current period.
parameters.name: period_id

blackline_new_audit_entry_trigger.description: Runs for each new audit trail entry in BlackLine. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.area: The part of BlackLine changed, such as Accounts.

parameters.description: Only changes in this area of BlackLine, such as Accounts. Leave empty for every area.
parameters.name: area

blackline_new_current_period_trigger.description: Runs each time BlackLine moves on to a new current period. The period that is current when the workflow is turned on doesn't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.is_current: True if it is the current period.
output.name: The period's name, such as October 2026.
output.period: The whole period as BlackLine gives it.

blackline_new_journal_trigger.description: Runs for each new journal entry in a BlackLine period (the current one unless you pick another) that the chosen role can see. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.journal: The whole journal as BlackLine lists it.
output.title: The journal's title.

parameters.description: The role whose journals to watch, such as Preparer. Leave empty for the connected user's default role.
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.description: The period to watch. Leave empty for the current period.
parameters.name: period_id

blackline_new_team_trigger.description: Runs for each new team in BlackLine. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The team's name.
output.parent_id: The id of the team it sits under, if any.
output.team: The whole team as BlackLine gives it.

blackline_new_user_trigger.description: Runs for each new user in BlackLine. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.is_active: True if they can sign in.
output.login_id: The name they sign in with.
output.user: The whole user as BlackLine gives it.

blackline_period_closed_trigger.description: Runs each time a period is closed in BlackLine. Ones closed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 500. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.is_current: True if it is the current period.
output.name: The period's name, such as October 2026.
output.period: The whole period as BlackLine gives it.

blackline_report_run_finished_trigger.description: Runs each time a report the connected user ran in BlackLine finishes. Ones finished before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.id: The report run's id, for 'Export report run'.
output.name: The report's name.
output.report_run: The whole report run, with its export links.

blackline_user_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each user added or changed in BlackLine. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.is_active: True if they can sign in.
output.login_id: The name they sign in with.
output.user: The whole user as BlackLine gives it.
